name: Maharashtra Scholarship Exam — Std 4 (PSE) & Std 7 (UPS)
local_name: प्राथमिक शिष्यवृत्ती परीक्षा (इ. ४ थी) · उच्च प्राथमिक शिष्यवृत्ती परीक्षा (इ. ७ वी)
body: Maharashtra State Council of Examination (MSCE), Pune
subject: First language · Maths · Third language · Intelligence

exam.label: Sun 21 Feb 2027
exam.source: MSCE notification no. मरापप/शिष्यवृत्ती/2026-27/4857 dated 27 Oct 2026

registration.label: Open · regular fee till 30 Nov 2026 · late fee till 31 Dec

result.label: Expected Jul–Aug 2027 (2026 cycle: provisional 25 Jul, final 11 Aug)

fee: ₹200 (entry ₹50 + exam ₹150); ₹125 for reserved categories / divyang in MSCERT-curriculum schools; +₹50 late (1–15 Dec), then +₹10/day (16–23 Dec) and +₹20/day (24–31 Dec). School affiliation ₹200/yr.
eligibility: Resident of Maharashtra studying in Std 4 or Std 7 in a recognised school (government, aided, unaided, permanently unaided or self-financed). Age on 1 June 2026: Std 4 ≤10 yrs (divyang ≤14); Std 7 ≤13 yrs (divyang ≤17). Over-age students may appear but receive no scholarship.
cbse_note: CBSE / ICSE / other-board students may appear; a separate state top-100 and district top-25 merit list with certificates is prepared for them, but no scholarship money is paid.
pattern: First Language 25 Q / 50 marks + Mathematics 50 Q / 100 marks
Third Language 25 Q / 50 marks + Intelligence Test 50 Q / 100 marks
pattern_notes: All MCQ, 4 options, exactly one correct; sets A–D; difficulty 30% easy / 40% medium / 30% hard; qualifying 40% in each paper; OMR, no negative marking.
media: Marathi, Urdu, Hindi, Gujarati, English, Telugu, Kannada — plus six semi-English options (Maths and Intelligence papers bilingual with English).
award: Std 4: ₹500/month for 3 years (16,693 scholarships). Std 7: ₹750/month for 3 years (16,588 scholarships). Allotted district-wise (and taluka-wise for Std 7) across rural/urban, category and Vidarbha-income (< ₹1 lakh) sub-quotas; a limited number of sets, so cut-off applies.
how_to_apply: Through the school only, online at puppssmsce.in (school login, UDISE code). No offline forms. Student photo + signature scan ≤100 KB; Aadhaar or enrolment number mandatory.
transition: Std 5 and Std 8 scholarship exams were held for the last time on 22 Feb 2026 (final results published). From 2026-27 only Std 4 and Std 7 run, in February.

body: Maharashtra State Council of Examination (MSCE), Pune — for the Ministry of Education's NMMS scheme
subject: Mental Ability (MAT) · Scholastic Aptitude (SAT)

exam.label: Sun 20 Dec 2026 · MAT 10:30–12:00 · SAT 1:30–3:00
exam.source: MSCE notification no. 3916 dated 7 Sep 2026; press release 4816 dated 21 Oct 2026

result.label: Expected first/second week of Feb 2027 (per MSCE information sheet)

fee: ₹120 regular (8 Sep–7 Oct); ₹240 late (8–14 Oct); ₹360 / ₹480 super-late (15–21 Oct). School affiliation ₹200/yr.
eligibility: Regular Class 8 student in a government, government-aided or local-body school in Maharashtra; parents' combined annual income below ₹3,50,000 (certificate for FY 2025-26); minimum 55% in Class 7 (50% for SC/ST).
cbse_note: Students of unaided private schools, Kendriya Vidyalayas, Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas, Sainik schools and government-hostel beneficiaries may sit the exam but are not eligible for the scholarship.
pattern: Mental Ability Test — reasoning, analysis, synthesis
Science 35 (Phy 11 · Chem 11 · Bio 13) + Social Science 35 (Hist 15 · Civics 5 · Geo 15) + Maths 20
pattern_notes: MCQ, 4 options, sets A–D; qualifying 40% combined MAT+SAT (32% for SC/ST/divyang); OMR; no negative marking; +30 min per paper for divyang.
media: Marathi, Urdu, Hindi, Gujarati, English, Telugu, Kannada — every student also gets the English version of the paper.
award: ₹1,000/month (₹12,000/year) from Class 9 to Class 12. Maharashtra quota: 11,682 of the national 1,00,000. Continuation needs first-attempt pass in Class 9 and 11 and ≥60% in Class 10 (55% SC/ST).
how_to_apply: Through the school online at mscenmms.in; caste/divyang certificates verified by the headmaster; admit cards via school login 10 days before the exam.

name: Rajasthan State Talent Search Examination (STSE) 2026
body: Board of Secondary Education Rajasthan (BSER), Ajmer
subject: MAT · Language (LCT) · Scholastic (SAT)

exam.label: Sun 22 Nov 2026 · 9:00 AM–1:00 PM · all 41 district HQs
exam.source: BSER notice सैल-7/STSE-2026/01 dated 14 Sep 2026 and STSE-2026 instruction booklet

fee: ₹300 general; ₹175 SC/ST/BPL/divyang/CWSN (certificate upload mandatory); +₹50 late; schools may collect ₹20 forwarding fee.
eligibility: Regular students of Class 10 and Class 12 in any recognised school in Rajasthan — central, public, Navodaya, convent, private, government and RMSA model schools — with at least 50% in Class 9 (for Class 10) or Class 11 (for Class 12).
cbse_note: Open to all boards. Scholarship money is restricted to students of government schools and Rajasthan model schools; others receive certificates and the top-20 cash incentives.
pattern: Language Comprehension Test (LCT) — Hindi or English
Scholastic Aptitude Test (SAT) — Class 10: Phy 25, Chem 25, Bio 20, Maths 20; Class 12: stream-wise 30/30/30 (Arts 23/23/23/21)
pattern_notes: All MCQ, 1 mark each, total 180; no negative marking; merit on MAT+LCT+SAT total; extra time for CWSN candidates. Syllabus: full previous-class syllabus (2025-26) plus current-year syllabus (2026-27).
award: Top 50 per category (Class 10; Class 12 Science; Class 12 Arts & Commerce) scoring ≥80%: ₹1,250/month in Classes 11–12 and ₹2,000/month through regular UG/PG study (government and model-school students). Incentives for the top 20 in each merit list: ₹4,000 (rank 1) and ₹2,000 (ranks 2–20). Scholar certificate >90%, Distinction certificate 80–90%.
how_to_apply: Online by the school through bser-exam.in/stse using the Board login; fee by ICICI Bank or Rajasthan Gramin Bank challan; hard copies posted to the Board.
